title: Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
summary: Comprehensive active-recall learning deck covering rare auspicious signs (Śaṅkha/Conch on Ketu, Flag on Sun/Saturn, Tree at line terminus, Chain on thumb Family Ring exception, Saturn Mount signs & lifelong career Trident), Double Life Line vs Supportive Mars Line (Sushant Singh Rajput case), Life Line trajectory (inward thumb curve longevity & motherland return vs outward expansion), Moon mount ending afflictions (addictions, female troubles, water hazards), Macchā Rekhā / Samrāṭ Yoga, Fate Line connections & duration of family support, Venus Mount in-laws & divorce markers, upward branches to mounts vs Mars defame cuts, three-stage Mars line progression (Life, Head depression, Heart trauma), Heart Line age formula (18-6-18-6-18), Poison Line (Lava Vasavīya), and real client case studies (33F kidney disease, Anurādhā ji, Jīveśa ji Mauritius temple visa).

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: What is the Śaṅkha (Conch) sign, where is it found, and what does it indicate?
cards.back:
A very rare auspicious sign resembling a conch with a circular spiral on top.

Location: Primarily in the Ketu Mount area near the wrist.
Significance: Indicates an exalted spiritual journey, high spiritual evolution, and sudden unexpected wealth gain.
cards.tip: Ketu mount spiral = Spiritual journey & sudden wealth

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: How do you distinguish a Flag (Dhvaja) sign from a Square, and what does the Flag signify?
cards.back:
• Flag: Closed on THREE sides and OPEN on one side (resembling a "P" or "F" pole with cloth).
• Square: Strictly closed on ALL FOUR sides.

Significance: Bestows widespread fame, high prestige, and immense willpower. Seen mostly on Sun or Saturn mounts.
cards.tip: Flag = 3 sides closed, 1 open (fame & willpower); Square = 4 sides closed

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: Where does a Tree sign appear, and what does it signify?
cards.back:
Found at the very terminus (last stretch) of a line, branching out with multiple ascending boughs.

Significance: Indicates tremendous growth, prosperity, enduring honor, and multiplies the strength of that parent line.
cards.tip: Tree branching at line terminus = Growth, prosperity & strength

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: Where is the ONLY place on the human hand where a Chain (Jañjīra) formation is considered auspicious?
cards.back:
On the FAMILY RING (the lowest bracelet crease at the base of the thumb).

A chain here is mandatory for a harmonious married and domestic family life. Anywhere else on lines or mounts, chains indicate struggle, illness, or weakness.
cards.tip: Thumb family ring = ONLY place where chains are positive

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: What is indicated if the family ring at the base of the thumb is completely straight without any chain loops?
cards.back: Domestic friction, lack of family cohesion, and marital dissatisfaction. The lecture states a chain here is "very necessary" for family joy.
cards.tip: Straight thumb ring = Lack of family warmth & marital strain

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: What are the effects of a Triangle, Square, and Fish on the Saturn Mount (Śani Parvat)?
cards.back:
• Triangle: Extremely auspicious sign for intellectual and occult depth.
• Square: Powerful protective shield against accidents and sudden ruin.
• Fish: Indicates growth and renown in a spiritual career.
cards.tip: Saturn: Triangle = occult depth, Square = protection, Fish = spiritual career

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.tag: TRIDENT AT END OF FATE LINE
cards.front: What does a Trident crowning the terminus of the Fate Line (Bhāgya Rekhā) signify?
cards.back:
1. Lifelong Career Drive: Strong desire for karma (action) and grand success in work.
2. Career Until Death: Professional activity and fame continuing past age 60, 70, and 80 without retirement (e.g. Dave ji).
cards.tip: Fate line trident = Career success lasting until end of life

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.tag: DOUBLE LIFE LINE VS MARS LINE
cards.front: What is the precise anatomical difference between a Double Life Line and a Supportive (Mars) Line?
cards.back:
• Double Life Line: Both lines emerge from the SAME root, or the second line TOUCHES / IS JOINED to the Life Line.
• Supportive Line (Mars Line): Runs parallel inside Venus at a distinct distance WITHOUT touching the Life Line.
cards.tip: Touching/joined = Double Life Line; Parallel separated = Supportive Mars Line

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: Does a Double Life Line mean a longer physical lifespan? What does it actually indicate?
cards.back:
NO! It does NOT guarantee a longer life.

It indicates the native lives a "double life" — managing two distinct careers, having two completely different modes of living, or transitioning successfully between two unrelated professional identities (e.g. Sushant Singh Rajput: engineer then actor).
cards.tip: Double life line = Dual careers/lifestyles, NOT doubled longevity

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: What hand features were observed in Sushant Singh Rajput’s hand in the class discussion?
cards.back:
1. Two joined Life Lines: One main line with a second line joined and growing darker (living two distinct lives: engineering to cinema).
2. Very straight Brain Line: Highly practical intellect (making classical impulsive suicide uncharacteristic by the Head Line alone).
3. Straight Heart Line: Controlled emotional baseline.
cards.tip: SSR hand: Joined double life line + straight practical head line

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: What does a Life Line that curves deep inward toward the thumb perimeter signify?
cards.back: Traditionally associated with high longevity (100+ years) and deep rootedness. It guarantees that the native will settle in or return to their native MOTHERLAND at the end of life, however far they travel.
cards.tip: Deep inward thumb curve = Longevity & final return to motherland

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: What do multiple branches radiating outward from the Life Line indicate?
cards.back: Continuous outward expansion: buying properties outside one's residential city (like Arvind ji), undertaking foreign travels, or establishing external commercial connections.
cards.tip: Outward branches = Territorial expansion & foreign travel

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: What is indicated when the Life Line runs straight into the Ketu Mount at its base?
cards.back: High spiritual inclination, interest in mokṣa, detachment from shallow materialism, and intense spiritual contemplation in later life.
cards.tip: Life line to Ketu = High spiritual inclination & detachment

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.tag: LIFE LINE ON MOON MOUNT IN MEN
cards.front: What afflictions can manifest in a male’s hand if the Life Line sweeps into an afflicted Moon Mount?
cards.back:
Moon is a female planet. In an afflicted male hand, it indicates:
• Addictions & substance abuse (fine lines on Moon)
• Wasteful expenditure
• Troubles, scandals, or accusations involving women
• Water accidents, hormonal imbalances, and insomnia.
cards.tip: Afflicted Moon ending = Addictions, female-related trouble, water danger

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: What danger does a Life Line that heads toward the Moon and SUDDENLY TERMINATES abruptly indicate?
cards.back: Acute danger from water (e.g. drowning accidents during rafting/boating), severe fluid-related diseases, water-borne infections, or hormonal collapse.
cards.tip: Abrupt stop on Moon = Danger from water & hormonal ailments

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: What is the Macchā Rekhā on the Life Line, and what paradox does it bring?
cards.back:
A rare specialized fish-like mark directly upon the Life Line stem.

Brings SAMRĀṬ YOGA (imperial power, high authority, royal dignity) at that age, BUT simultaneously triggers physical health complications.
cards.tip: Macchā rekhā = Samrāṭ Yoga (royal status) coupled with health issues

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: How is the duration of family support measured when a branch connects the Life Line to the Fate Line?
cards.back:
Trace the connecting stretch between the two lines: the support begins at the junction age and endures for the entire length the connecting branch runs.

Cross-reference the Life Line age scale against the Fate Line age scale at the junction point.
cards.tip: Support duration = Entire length of connecting branch

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: How did the teacher distinguish conditional family support from open family support?
cards.back:
1. Conditional/Limited Support: Family helps within strict boundaries ("we spend only this much; pursue only this career").
2. Open/Empowering Support: Family backs the native with complete freedom ("we stand behind you; do whatever you wish"), granting deep mental peace.
cards.tip: Conditional support = Restricted boundary; Open support = Freedom & peace

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: When an outward line departs from the Life/Fate junction near age 35 and touches the career line, how is it read?
cards.back: As professional expansion and travel for the sake of WORK. The palmist must not read it as isolated personal wanderlust, because its connection to the career line ties it directly to enterprise.
cards.tip: Outward branch touching Fate line = Work-related travel & expansion

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: How is the Venus Mount divided between Mars influence and pure Venus influence?
cards.back:
• Upper Venus (near thumb web): Lower Mars area, filled with small diagonal "enemy lines" causing domestic friction.
• Lower Venus: Pure Venus territory. Horizontal lines represent family/in-law influences; vertical lines represent progeny/children.
cards.tip: Upper = Mars enemy lines; Lower horizontal = Family/in-law relations

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.tag: HORIZONTAL VENUS LINE STOPPING VS TOUCHING
cards.front: Contrast a horizontal Venus line that STOPS BEFORE the Life Line versus one that TOUCHES it.
cards.back:
• Stopping before Life Line: Normal internal family disagreements that stay confined to private thoughts without disrupting daily routine.
• Touching Life Line: Family/in-law friction that penetrates daily life, becoming an inescapable chronic distress and potential divorce marker.
cards.tip: Stopping short = Private disagreement; Touching = Disruptive daily crisis

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.tag: VENUS LINE CUTTING THROUGH FATE LINE
cards.front: What is the consequence if a horizontal Venus line pierces the Life Line and extends to CUT the Fate Line?
cards.back: Severe domestic or in-law interference that directly damages the native’s career, profession, and financial earnings.
cards.tip: Venus line cutting Fate line = In-laws/family destroying career & wealth

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: What does an island situated at the end of a horizontal Venus influence line signify?
cards.back: Acute marital breakdown or divorce. It represents a native who internalizes domestic grief so deeply without speaking that it turns into chronic internal disease.
cards.tip: Island on Venus branch = Internalized domestic grief & divorce

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: What physical vulnerability is indicated when a line originates on Venus and travels across to the Moon Mount?
cards.back: Throat-related ailments, vocal cord afflictions, thyroid vulnerability, or respiratory tract sensitivity.
cards.tip: Venus to Moon line = Throat and vocal disorders

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: What does an upward branch rising from the Life Line toward the Saturn Mount indicate (as in the teacher's hand)?
cards.back: Early career breakthrough, rapid professional rise, and sudden financial elevation (e.g. the teacher securing her government appointment at age 22–25).
cards.tip: Upward branch to Saturn = Early career milestone & government post

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.tag: BRANCH TO SUN VS MARS CUT TO SUN
cards.front: How do you distinguish an auspicious Sun branch from an inauspicious Mars line affecting the Sun?
cards.back:
• Auspicious Sun Branch: Rises from the OUTSIDE / Life Line itself upward to Sun Mount = Renown and fame (prasiddhi).
• Inauspicious Mars Line: Emerges from the INSIDE (Lower Mars) and crosses over to cut the Sun line = Defame (apavāda) and public disgrace.
cards.tip: Rising from Life line = Fame; Slashing from inside Mars = Defame

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: Describe the 3 progressive stages of affliction as an aggressive Mars line cuts across the palm.
cards.back:
1. Touching Life Line: Disruption and crises in physical life and vitality.
2. Cutting Head Line: Severe mental depression and cognitive breakdown (timed by Head line age).
3. Cutting Heart Line: Deep emotional trauma and heartbreak (timed by Heart line age, ~40–45+).
cards.tip: Life cut = Physical crisis → Head cut = Depression → Heart cut = Heartbreak

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: What is the fundamental age calculation formula across the Heart Line revealed in Lecture 21?
cards.back:
Under each finger base = 18 years.
In each inter-finger cleft = 6 years.
Sequence: 18 (Mercury) → 6 → 18 (Sun) → 6 → 18 (Saturn).
cards.tip: Under finger = 18 yrs; Inter-finger gap = 6 yrs

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: Why does the palmist cross-check "three places" for the same age when predicting a major life event?
cards.back: To ensure foolproof accuracy: checking (1) the Heart Line, (2) the Fate Line, and (3) the Life Line for that same chronological milestone. If all three display afflictions, a major crisis is certain.
cards.tip: Triple check: Life line + Heart line + Fate line for definitive timing

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: In the 33-year-old female friend’s case (kidney function at 6%), what physical hand signs confirmed severe chronic illness?
cards.back:
1. Tucked thumb and artificial nails (hiding vitality, harboring bacteria).
2. Initial dot on Life line with chained, broken line up to age 40.
3. Deflated, flattened Venus mount (pichkā huā) with small surface area.
4. Bluish tinge across palm and lines (poor blood oxygenation, toxic retention).
cards.tip: Blue lines + deflated Venus + chained life line = Severe systemic disease

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.tag: KIDNEY DISEASE CASE – PARASITE LINE CORRELATION
cards.front: How did the parasite line in the 33-year-old friend's palm correlate to her real-life domestic stress?
cards.back: Two years prior, her husband’s divorced sister, two children, and mother-in-law moved into her home, creating suffocating domestic stress that correlated exactly with the dark parasite line running beside her Life Line.
cards.tip: Dark parasite line = Domestic turmoil from dependent in-laws

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: What is the Lava Vasavīya (Poison Line / Sister of Mercury), and what ailments does it cause?
cards.back:
A transverse crease starting near Mercury/percussion and sweeping toward the Moon Mount.

Significance: Chronic toxic accumulation, acute liver diseases, digestive breakdown; frequently seen in individuals addicted to alcohol or heavy rich diets.
cards.tip: Mercury to Moon crease = Poison line (liver disease & addictions)

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.tag: ANURĀDHĀ JI CASE – MOLE ON MOON
cards.front: In Anurādhā ji’s hand, what did a black mole on the Moon Mount combined with a downward line indicate?
cards.back: Severe vulnerability to water-borne diseases, emotional depression, and fluid imbalance. However, a protective triangle on her Life Line provided survival safety.
cards.tip: Mole on Moon = Health & fluid vulnerability; Triangle = Survival shield

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: In Jīveśa ji's hand (approved for temple work in Mauritius at age 26), what did his Moon Fate Line and dual Head Lines indicate?
cards.back:
1. Fate Line from Moon Mount: Work connected to pūjā-pāṭha, temple rituals, or public devotion abroad.
2. Small island around age 30 with uneven line: Initial struggles adjusting overseas.
3. Two Mind Lines: High intellectual lunar activity, but risk of old-age memory loss/dementia.
cards.tip: Moon Fate line = Temple service abroad; Dual mind lines = High intellect & dementia risk

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: What did the teacher note about the permanence of signs and symbols on the palm?
cards.back: Signs and symbols appear and disappear on the human hand over time in response to changes in karma, lifestyle, psychological discipline, and health.
cards.tip: Palm signs are dynamic — they form and dissolve with karma

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: Why did the teacher warn against long artificial nails in the 33-year-old patient's case?
cards.back: She remarked that artificial nails are "the root of half of human diseases" by trapping bacteria and obscuring the natural nail bed, color, and lunula needed for physical diagnosis.
cards.tip: Artificial nails obscure diagnostic signs and harbor infection

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: What psychological state is revealed when a client tucks their thumb inside their fingers in photographs?
cards.back: Unconscious defensive withdrawal, feeling overwhelmed, hiding one’s personal willpower, and an internal sense of helplessness under chronic stress.
cards.tip: Tucked thumb in photos = Defensive emotional withdrawal & vulnerability

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: What does a distinct bluish coloration across the palm skin and palm lines indicate medically?
cards.back: Severe failure of blood purification, excess carbon dioxide/toxin retention in the bloodstream, and acute kidney or liver filtration collapse (as in the 6% kidney function patient).
cards.tip: Bluish tint = Blood purification failure & toxic retention

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: What does a deflated, flattened (pichkā huā) Venus mount with small surface area indicate in a 32-year-old client?
cards.back: Premature exhaustion of vitality, severe depletion of reproductive ojas, and deep domestic or physical fatigue rather than normal youthful vigor.
cards.tip: Deflated Venus at 32 = Exhaustion of vitality and domestic burnout

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: What does a transverse crease just above the joint between the Saturn and Jupiter fingers indicate?
cards.back: Whatever work, study, or enterprise the native undertakes, material fruits and financial compensation will be distinctly lower than expected.
cards.tip: Saturn-Jupiter joint line = Diminished material gains from career

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: What is an Impression Line rising from the Moon Mount toward the Fate Line, and what does it reveal?
cards.back: A faint upward line from the Moon Mount toward the career line. It indicates (1) a deep teenage role-model impression (creative inspirations, close friends), or (2) a love marriage.
cards.tip: Moon impression line = Teenage role-model influence or love marriage

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: What talents are conferred by an upward branch rising from the Life Line toward the Mercury Mount?
cards.back: Strong commercial acumen, aptitude for business and independent research, deep studiousness, and a natural social warmth for making friends quickly.
cards.tip: Life line branch to Mercury = Business acumen, research drive, social charm

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: In the Lecture 21 aging demonstration, how is the bottom reference point anchored?
cards.back:
At the exact MIDPOINT of the wrist (kalāī).

The palmist ignores whether the Life Line itself turns inward or outward — the reference line connects the Life Line origin straight to the wrist midpoint (representing a 75-year span).
cards.tip: Bottom anchor = Exact geometric midpoint of wrist

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: Where is Age 30 located in the Lecture 21 aging demonstration?
cards.back: Age 30 sits slightly ABOVE the geometric midpoint of the Life Line span, not at the exact physical 50% center.
cards.tip: Age 30 sits slightly above the physical midpoint

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: Why did the teacher strictly advise against planning a second child in the 33-year-old patient’s case?
cards.back: Because the Life Line was heavily chained and broken with active parasite lines up to age 40. Planning a pregnancy during active organ failure and depleted vitality would be life-threatening.
cards.tip: Chained/distressed Life line = Postpone pregnancy until line heals

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: What double-edged sword was identified in Jīveśa ji regarding having Two Mind Lines?
cards.back: Having two Mind Lines sharpens intellect, lunar depth, and multitasking, BUT carries a notable vulnerability to old-age forgetfulness, cognitive exhaustion, or dementia.
cards.tip: Dual Mind lines = Sharp lunar intellect, but risk of old-age memory loss

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.tag: DAVE JI FATE LINE TRIDENT ANALOGY
cards.front: Why did the teacher cite Dave ji as a living demonstration of the Fate Line Trident?
cards.back: To show that a trident at the top of the Fate Line keeps a native actively working, honored, and intellectually productive past ages 70–80 without retiring.
cards.tip: Dave ji analogy = Lifelong active career continuing past 80

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: What is the fundamental difference in meaning between Vertical lines and Horizontal lines on the Venus Mount?
cards.back:
• Vertical lines on Venus: Progeny / children’s lines.
• Horizontal lines on Venus: Family, spousal, and in-law relationship lines (and domestic friction when crossing toward Life Line).
cards.tip: Vertical Venus = Children; Horizontal Venus = Family/in-laws/stress

cards.sourceTitle: Hasta Sāmudrika Śāstra — Signs & Symbols, and the Life Line – Part 03
cards.front: How does a palmist know when a client is finally emerging from a chronic crisis phase shown by Mars and parasite lines?
cards.back: When the lines visibly lighten in shade. As the heavy dark pigmentation fades and the line becomes lighter and finer, the crisis period subsides and recovery begins.
cards.tip: Dark lines fading to lighter shades = Subsidence of crisis
